"""Camera/depth-guided controller. All measurements use the standard robot client.
Interactive commands are recorded in commands.log; actions are saved as arrays.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np, json, os, time, code
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); root='/app/output'; count=0

def capture(res,tag='obs'):
 global obs,p,q,count
 obs=res; p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']); q=p[4:11].copy(); count+=1
 path=f'{root}/{count:03d}_{tag}'; res.save(path)
 print('SAVED',path,'time_left',res.meta['time_left_s'],'eef',np.round(p[26:29],5),'q',np.round(q,5),flush=True)
 return res

def look(): return capture(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'))
def movej(target,seconds=2,grip=None,base=None,torso=0,mode=-1,tag='move'):
 target=np.asarray(target); n=max(1,round(seconds/.05)); A=np.zeros((n,13)); A[:,:7]=np.linspace(q,target,n); A[:,7]=p[36] if grip is None else grip; A[:,12]=mode
 if base is not None: A[:,8:11]=base
 A[:,11]=torso
 np.save(f'{root}/actions_{count+1:03d}.npy',A)
 return capture(r.submit('joint_position',A,include_depth=True,video='none',note=tag),tag)
def point(cam,u,v):
 c=obs.meta['cameras'][cam]; K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl']); dep=obs.depth[cam]; dep=dep[-1] if dep.ndim==3 else dep
 z=float(dep[int(v),int(u)]); a=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z]); return T[:3,:3]@a+T[:3,3]
def cloud(cam):
 c=obs.meta['cameras'][cam]; K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl']); dep=obs.depth[cam]; dep=dep[-1] if dep.ndim==3 else dep
 v,u=np.indices(dep.shape); a=np.stack([(u-K[0,2])*dep/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*dep/K[1,1],-dep],-1); return a@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]
look()
class LogConsole(code.InteractiveConsole):
 def push(self,line):
  with open(root+'/commands.log','a') as f:f.write(line+'\n')
  return super().push(line)
LogConsole(globals()).interact(banner='Robot controller ready')
